description: Structured fields extracted from source Markdown. B and P remain separate datasets; personal fields are retained for assignment completeness and are never model inputs.

publication.authorization_note: Requester confirmed on 2026-11-19 that the records are simulated and have explicit public-release authorization.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Original resume number, unique only within its dataset.

columns.name: candidate_name
columns.description: Name as written in the source Markdown.

columns.name: age_raw
columns.description: Original age field text.

columns.name: age_years
columns.description: Numeric age parsed from age_raw; retained for the assignment dataset only.

columns.name: current_monthly_salary_raw
columns.description: Original monthly salary field; null means the source has no value.

columns.name: employment_start_raw
columns.description: Original work-start-date field text.

columns.name: work_years_raw
columns.description: Original experience-duration clause used to derive work_years.

columns.name: work_years
columns.description: Parsed work experience in years.

columns.name: acm_status
columns.description: Normalized ACM state preserving award, participation, and missing-record distinctions.

columns.name: acm_award
columns.description: Whether an explicit award record exists.

columns.name: target_role
columns.description: Target role as described in the resume.

columns.name: skills_raw
columns.description: Original skills description with Markdown wrappers normalized.

columns.name: work_summary
columns.description: Work content and continuation lines.

columns.name: project_duties
columns.description: Project responsibilities and continuation lines.

columns.name: teamwork_summary
columns.description: Teamwork field text.

columns.name: career_direction
columns.description: Career direction field text.

columns.name: project_background
columns.description: Project background field text.

columns.name: github_url
columns.description: Original GitHub field; missing values are represented as source text when present.

columns.name: school_name
columns.description: School and education description extracted from the education field.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Path of the source Markdown file within its ZIP.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the original Markdown bytes.

columns.name: label_grade
columns.description: Original B-enterprise A/B/C grade.

columns.name: label_binary
columns.description: A/B=1, C=0. Not present in P.
